description: Equip your business in Kiribati with autonomous AI agents. Run isolated 24/7 cloud computers, automate research, coding, and apps via Telegram. Start free trial.
h1: Empower South Tarawa with 24/7 AI Cloud Agents
sub: Deploy personal AI bots with dedicated cloud computers that operate continuously, keeping your projects running across Pacific and global time zones even when your phone is off.
audience: Maritime operators, civil servants, remote consultants, fisheries managers, and Pacific trade entrepreneurs across Tarawa, Kiritimati, and outer atolls.
manifesto: Across 33 atolls spanning three time zones, Ceyo runs tireless cloud computers that handle research, maritime logistics, coding, and reporting without depending on stable local hardware or battery life.

uses.d: Track Western and Central Pacific tuna compliance guidelines, monitor regional vessel transshipments, and summarize maritime bulletins automatically.
Scan multilateral funding portals, draft development project proposals, and maintain progress trackers across connected Google Sheets.
Manage freight inquiries, compile supply requirements between Tarawa and outer islands, and automate logistics records in Telegram groups.
Let your coding agent build, test, and host administrative portals and lightweight web applications inside its secure cloud environment.
Deploy browser agents to navigate overseas supplier catalogs in Fiji, Australia, and New Zealand, comparing shipping costs and equipment availability.
Convert regional development reports into executive memos, schedule recurring weekly summaries, and synchronize deadlines across calendars.

steps.d: Select your specialist bot and receive an isolated cloud computer ready to execute workflows immediately.
Integrate Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, and over 1,000 work platforms with secure authorization.
Delegate autonomous web research, coding sprints, or daily scheduled briefs that run 24 hours a day.

chapters.d: As sunrise touches the Tarawa lagoon, your Telegram agent delivers a synthesized digest of overnight communications and regional shipping alerts. Key priorities are already prioritized in your connected workspace.

Your agent opens its autonomous browser to navigate multiple overseas vendor catalogs, recording equipment specifications and drafting quote comparison tables. It fills out supplier inquiry forms without manual supervision.
In its sandboxed cloud terminal, your coding bot refines database scripts, compiles analytics for regional trade data, and checks for errors. You review the completed web preview on your phone.

Even after you disconnect from the network and local power rests, your cloud agents continue monitoring international tenders across European and American time zones. All findings await your next session.

faq.q: What are the subscription plans and trial terms?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial featuring up to 1,000,000 tokens daily; a payment card is linked upon registration and charged only after the trial finishes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my agents keep working if my internet disconnects in Tarawa?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs independently inside its own isolated cloud computer in high-availability data centers. Tasks, web browsing, data scraping, and coding jobs execute 24/7 regardless of local network stability or whether your phone is switched off.

faq.q: Can multiple bots collaborate in Telegram group chats?
faq.a: Yes. You can introduce several specialized bots into private Telegram groups or direct conversations. They share long-term memory, divide complex tasks, exchange files, and collaborate as a multidisciplinary team.

faq.q: Which tools and services can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects seamlessly with more than 1,000 applications, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, CRMs, calendars, and cloud storage systems, enabling end-to-end task automation.

faq.q: Can Ceyo handle communications in English and Gilbertese?
faq.a: Ceyo operates natively in English for comprehensive technical, legal, and operational tasks, and can process text prompts, translate documents, and manage communications involving Gilbertese (Kiribati language).
